scope: Strict private response contract for location-scoped landscape conservation aggregates.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at every response object level
constraints.enums: match migration 154 checks for habitat, corridor, and hedgerow values
constraints.counts: strict nonnegative integers; grouped record counts are positive
constraints.numeric_values: finite; only verified buffer compliance is constrained to 0..100
constraints.group_bounds: 200 habitats, 30 corridors, 25 hedgerows, and 9 verified-buffer groups from schema dimensions
constraints.request_path: top-level location identifier must match the requested path
constraints.privacy: aggregate-only projection; row identifiers, names, geometry, notes, assessor, and metadata are excluded by the service

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes one source/API response-contract slice only; live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate gates.
